description: This file defines the EntityTypeListener class in Drupal, which reacts to CRUD operations on entity types, manages schema and field definitions, and dispatches related events.

classes.name: EntityTypeListener
classes.description: A class that reacts to CRUD operations on entity types, manages schema and field definitions, and dispatches events within Drupal's entity system.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the EntityTypeListener with dependencies: entity type manager, field manager, event dispatcher, and schema repository.

methods.name: onEntityTypeCreate
methods.description: Handles logic when a new entity type is created, including updating schema repository and dispatching creation event.

methods.name: onFieldableEntityTypeCreate
methods.description: Handles logic when a fieldable entity type is created, including updating schema repository and dispatching creation event.

methods.name: onEntityTypeUpdate
methods.description: Handles updates to an entity type, including updating schema repository and dispatching update event.

methods.name: onEntityTypeDelete
methods.description: Handles deletion of an entity type, including cleaning up schema repository and dispatching delete event.

methods.name: onFieldableEntityTypeUpdate
methods.description: Handles updates to a fieldable entity type, including schema updates and event dispatching, with sandbox support.

methods.name: clearCachedDefinitions
methods.description: Clears cached entity and field definitions to ensure updates are applied.
